audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart carried 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[4..6] and the packet both read Zed.
audit.why: Annie has no dash or blink in kit, so from 6 onward Death Mark plus a shadow kills her outright whenever Pyromania is uncharged; the first four rows really are a skill check on her stun counter and stay Skill.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side=Zed, phases[5].side=Zed, phases[6].side=Zed; rows 0-3 left as Skill because both layers already agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike prose never said what gates the level 6 window.
audit.why: The gate is Pyromania's four-spell counter and Molten Shield's 10s, not a generic 'answer'.
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes and breakdown.mid now key the windows to a spent stun and her lack of any dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were never stated. Annie begins the game and every respawn with Pyromania already available, so level 1 and every post-death step-up carry a live stun. Molten Shield damages enemies who strike her with attacks OR spells, so it punishes the whole Q-E scissor string, not just autos.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available'; 'damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells'.
audit.corrected: The spawn-charged stun is stated in phases[0].why, the Molten Shield reflect in breakdown.cooldowns and tradeGood.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries real numbers.
audit.corrected: Q 4s, W 7s, Molten Shield 10s, and the four-spell Pyromania counter.
